name: Foresight Mental Health
one_liner: Therapy, psychiatry, ADHD testing and intensive outpatient care, mostly by video, from a California-based practice in five states.
best_for: People in California and the other states Foresight serves who want therapy and psychiatry under one practice
People who want to use insurance for medication management or ADHD testing
People who need an intensive outpatient program but want to stay at home
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who want a published self-pay price before booking
short_description: Foresight Mental Health is an outpatient practice offering therapy, psychiatry and medication management, mostly by video with some clinics, in five US states.
long_description: Foresight Mental Health is an outpatient mental health practice founded in Berkeley, California in 2018. It offers individual therapy (including CBT and DBT), psychiatry and medication management, care for children and adolescents, perinatal mental health, ADHD testing and an intensive outpatient program, mostly by video with some in-person clinics; TMS for treatment-resistant depression has been offered in Georgia. It cut its footprint from 24 states to nine in 2022 and now operates in five, with California the largest; it also lists programs in Arizona, Florida and Georgia. It bills insurance (its Arizona listing names Blue Cross Blue Shield, Aetna, Cigna, MultiPlan, Magellan and ComPsych) and does not publish self-pay prices. There are no published studies of Foresight's own service.
patient_summary: You book therapy or psychiatry with Foresight and usually meet your clinician by video, with some in-person clinics. It bills your insurance, so you pay your plan's copay; ask Foresight for self-pay rates, which are not published. It only serves people in the states where it operates.

pricing.starting_price: Copay with insurance; self-pay rates not published
pricing.notes: Bills insurance; its Arizona listing names Blue Cross Blue Shield, Aetna, Cigna, MultiPlan, Magellan and ComPsych. Contact Foresight for cash-pay rates.

privacy.notes: Privacy notice (read 2026-10-27) says it lets third parties collect data for interest-based advertising, uses Google Ads across websites, and discloses data to advertising and marketing partners for their own purposes; deletion depends on where you live.

seo.meta_description: Foresight Mental Health offers virtual psychiatry and therapy in 5 states. Insurance accepted including Medicare. Sessions $80-450. IOP/PHP programs available.

faqs.q: What states is Foresight Mental Health available in?
faqs.a: Only 5 states as of May 2025: Arizona, California, Florida, Georgia, and Texas. Coverage has shrunk—they operated in 11 states in early 2024, then 7, now just 5. Check their site for current availability before booking.

faqs.q: How much does Foresight cost without insurance?
faqs.a: $80-450 per session depending on the service. Therapy sessions are on the lower end, psychiatry and specialized services higher. ADHD testing is additional. Prices vary by provider credentials.
Yes, as of July 2024. They also accept most major commercial insurance plans. This is unusual for a virtual psychiatry provider—many competitors are cash-pay only.

faqs.q: What services does Foresight offer beyond regular therapy?
faqs.a: Psychiatry with medication management, ADHD testing (IVA-2 CPT), intensive outpatient programs (IOP), partial hospitalization programs (PHP), and specialized programs for teens and maternal mental health. TMS is available in Georgia only.

primary_uses: Therapy for anxiety, depression and trauma

availability.note: Five US states, California the largest; programs are also listed in Arizona, Florida and Georgia.
